description: This file defines an abstract class 'ConnectionFactory' responsible for creating and managing network connections using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Connections within the Orleans Runtime Messaging namespace. It handles connection configuration, lazy initialization of connection delegates, and provides an asynchronously accessible method to establish connections.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: An abstract class that provides the mechanism to create and configure network connections, intended for extension to implement specific connection creation logic.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Establishes a connection asynchronously to the specified SiloAddress.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Virtual method allowing subclasses to configure the connection builder.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to create a Connection instance given a SiloAddress and ConnectionContext.
